info.title: publicrecords Actors
info.description: Etsy listings and shop sales, sports odds, ATS job postings, government tenders, grants, awards and council meetings, company social profiles and forecast calibration. Each operation runs one publicrecords Actor on the caller's own Apify account and returns result rows.

queries.title: Search keywords
queries.description: Keywords to search, one per line (e.g. ceramic mug). Each keyword lands on Etsy's /market page, then pages through Etsy's own search API — every listing on the page (rendered and lazy-loaded), in Etsy's rank order.

sort.title: Sort
sort.description: Order of results, as on Etsy's own sort menu. Applies to search keywords (a market phrase with a sort set runs as a keyword search).

minPrice.title: Min price
minPrice.description: Lowest price to include, in whole units of the shop currency shown to your proxy's region (e.g. 10 = $10). Leave empty for no minimum.

maxPrice.title: Max price
maxPrice.description: Highest price to include, whole units. Leave empty for no maximum.

marketPhrases.title: Market phrases
marketPhrases.description: Phrases for Etsy's /market/ pages (any phrase resolves). Example: personalized dog collar

categoryUrls.title: Category URLs
categoryUrls.description: Etsy category pages, e.g. https://www.etsy.com/c/jewelry/necklaces (no query string). Read in Etsy's default order.

maxPages.title: Max pages per input
maxPages.description: Pages per input, 1–20 (Etsy's own cap). On the Standby/MCP endpoint one call stops at 240 s and says so (truncated:true with pagesDone/pagesRequested); big jobs belong in a batch run.

maxItems.title: Max listings per run (0 = no cap)
maxItems.description: Stop after this many listing rows across all inputs. Default 20: one keyword on defaults costs $0.00005 + 20 x $0.004 = $0.08005 (about $0.08) on the Free plan. Raise it (or set 0 for no cap) to get more pages.

maxCacheAgeHours.title: Max snapshot age (hours)
maxCacheAgeHours.description: Serve a keyword from our recent snapshot of the same search when it is at most this many hours old and holds every row you asked for; otherwise fetch live. Snapshot rows say data_source "cache", stale true and as_of (when they were read live), and are charged like live rows. 0 = always fetch live.

fillLazyCards.title: Return every listing on the page
fillLazyCards.description: Etsy renders 12 cards and lazy-loads the rest (48 more on page 1). On, the run fetches them the way Etsy's own page does, so you get the whole page in rank order. Off, you get the 12 rendered cards per page only (faster, fewer requests on your proxy).

is_star_seller.title: Star Seller shops only
is_star_seller.description: Only return listings from Star Seller shops.

free_shipping.title: Free shipping only
free_shipping.description: Only return listings with free shipping.

is_discounted.title: On sale only
is_discounted.description: Only return listings currently on sale.

is_handmade_only.title: Handmade only
is_handmade_only.description: Only return listings Etsy flags as handmade.

is_personalizable.title: Personalizable only
is_personalizable.description: Only return listings that offer personalization.

max_processing_days.title: Ready to ship within (days)
max_processing_days.description: Only return listings whose processing time is at most this many days (Etsy's ready-to-ship filter).

ship_to.title: Ships to (country code)
ship_to.description: Two-letter code, e.g. US, GB, DE.

source.title: Source
source.description: Optional free-text label for this run (for example the Make template that started it). Copied onto every listing row and onto RUN_SUMMARY so template runs can be filtered. Leave empty if you do not need it.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Etsy blocks datacenter IPs. Default: Apify Proxy RESIDENTIAL, included in the event prices (no separate proxy or compute charge). Your own residential proxy works too. A blocked page is never charged.

shops.title: Shop names
shops.description: Etsy shop names (the part after etsy.com/shop/). Leave empty to use the keyword or category filters.

keywords.title: Keywords in shop title
keywords.description: Case-insensitive words matched against the shop title and headline.

category.title: Panel category
category.description: Exact panel category label, matched case-insensitively, e.g. "kids & baby > toys", "home & living > home decor > scatter cushions", "art & collectibles > fine art ceramics". The label is filled for about 0.7% of shops, so a category filter returns only those shops. Empty = all.

minSales.title: Minimum lifetime sales
minSales.description: Only shops at or above this sales counter.

since.title: Changed since (date)
since.description: ISO date. Return only shops whose counters changed since this date. Empty = all matching shops.

maxShops.title: Max shops
maxShops.description: Upper bound on rows returned (and charged).

Input_legistar_meetings_scraper.title: Legistar Meetings Scraper
Input_legistar_meetings_scraper.description: Public Granicus Legistar Web API. Client slug is the first label of {slug}.legistar.com (e.g. seattle). chicago currently 500s; phila 403s.

clients.title: Client slugs
clients.description: Legistar client codes. Use the hostname label of {slug}.legistar.com. Working examples: seattle, milwaukee, madison, oakland, sanjose, boston, denver, columbus.

dateFrom.title: From date
dateFrom.description: Inclusive YYYY-MM-DD (EventDate / MatterIntroDate). Default: 30 days ago.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on dataset rows (events + matters combined).

includeEventItems.title: Include agenda item titles
includeEventItems.description: Extra HTTP call per event. Titles flattened into eventItemTitles (pipe-separated). Default off.

queries.title: Identifiers to resolve
queries.description: One per line. A website domain (acme.com), any organization or profile URL (https://www.instagram.com/acme, https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme), a prefixed handle (ig:acme, x:acme, tiktok:acme, yt:@acme, fb:acme, gh:acme), a Google Maps place ID (ChIJ…), an SEC CIK/ticker (cik:320193, ticker:NET), an LEI — or a company name, optionally with a location ("Acme Plumbing, Toronto"). Names resolve only when exactly one candidate is unambiguous; otherwise you get a ranked `candidates` row (free) to pick from. Organizations and places only — people are refused.

query.title: Single identifier
query.description: One identifier or company name (for agents, Zapier/Make steps, quick checks). Output defaults to compact for a single query.

inputDatasetId.title: Enrich a dataset (on-ramp)
inputDatasetId.description: ID of any dataset — a Google Maps, LinkedIn jobs or company-scraper run, or an uploaded CSV. Each row's website field is resolved and the result is attached to the row as `crosswalk`; all original fields pass through. Leave `queries` empty when using this.

domainField.title: Website field in that dataset
domainField.description: Auto-detected (website, websiteUrl, companyUrl, url, domain, homepage…) when empty.

maxRows.title: Max rows to enrich
maxRows.description: Maximum number of dataset rows to enrich in one run when inputDatasetId is set.

outputFormat.title: Output format
outputFormat.description: auto (default): compact for a single `query`, full for batches and datasets. compact: flat record with ids, urls, confidence and a verified flag — best for tool calls and spreadsheets. full: complete record with the evidence trail per link.
x-enumTitles: Auto (compact for one query, full for batches)

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: resolve: resolve the queries (default). healthcheck: run the canary set and FAIL the run on degradation (schedule hourly; wire an alert to run failure). reverify: re-resolve slice k of n of the graph with change events (schedule daily). export: dump the whole graph to the dataset (no charges). forget: purge the organizations in forgetIds. buildSecIndex: build the SEC ticker/CIK ↔ domain index used to enrich public companies (run monthly). seed: pre-resolve organizations (list / SEC / Wikidata) so first-touch lookups are served from the graph (still billed as entity-resolved). healthcheck / reverify / seed / buildSecIndex: publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs. export / forget: normal buyer/ops.
x-enumTitles: Healthcheck (canaries); publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs
Re-verify graph slice; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs
Build SEC index; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs
Seed the graph; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

probeMode.title: Verification depth
probeMode.description: direct (default): free public endpoints only; Instagram/Facebook links are reported as not_attempted unless enableChildProbes is true. The listed Store price covers this path and excludes optional child probes. auto / actors (experimental, untested by us): Instagram and Facebook confirmation starts official Store child Actors only when enableChildProbes is true; the buyer pays those Store Actor charges (we do not absorb them). Historical lift of probe vs direct is ≈ 0%. actors: confirm every platform through Store Actors (buyer-paid child charges; Instagram/Facebook still require enableChildProbes). declared: read the organization's website only.
x-enumTitles: Auto — experimental Store Actor probes (buyer pays child IG/FB charges)
Actors — experimental; Store Actors for every platform (buyer pays)

enableChildProbes.title: Enable Instagram/Facebook child probes
enableChildProbes.description: When true, Instagram/Facebook Store Actors run on the user's account at those Actors' own rates; default off so listed Crosswalk price is the true price without child spend.

maxChildRuns.title: Max child runs
maxChildRuns.description: Max Instagram/Facebook child runs that reached RUNNING in this parent run (one batched Instagram call plus one batched Facebook call). A start failure does not count. Default 2.

maxChildCostUsd.title: Max child cost (USD)
maxChildCostUsd.description: Stop starting further Instagram/Facebook children when read-back charged USD reaches this amount. Default 1.00. Each child Actor.call also sets maxTotalChargeUsd to min(0.25, remaining budget).

actorProbesPerEntity.title: Actor probes per organization
actorProbesPerEntity.description: Cap on Store-Actor confirmations per organization. Instagram and Facebook count only when enableChildProbes is true (direct, auto, or actors). Instagram + Facebook = 2.

actorProbesPerRun.title: Actor probes per run
actorProbesPerRun.description: Hard cap on Store-Actor confirmations for the whole run; beyond it, links are reported as not_attempted. Keeps sub-run spend predictable.

maxProbesPerEntity.title: Max platform probes per entity
maxProbesPerEntity.description: Upper bound on reverse-confirmation requests made for one organization. Keeps cost predictable in actors mode.

cacheTtlDays.title: Cache freshness (days)
cacheTtlDays.description: A cached record younger than this is returned without re-resolving and billed as entity-resolved. Set 0 to always re-resolve.

forceRefresh.title: Force refresh
forceRefresh.description: Ignore the cache and re-resolve every query. Identity-change events are still computed against the cached record.

emitChangeEvents.title: Emit identity-change events
emitChangeEvents.description: When a re-resolved organization differs from its cached record (new domain, moved handle, closed place, rebrand), push an identity_change row.

graphStoreName.title: Graph store name
graphStoreName.description: Named key-value store in your account that holds the identity graph. Leave empty to use crosswalk-graph-<this Actor's ID>, so every run of this Actor compounds the same graph.

sharedGraphStoreId.title: Shared graph store (advanced)
sharedGraphStoreId.description: ID of the publisher's public, pre-seeded graph store. Reads fall through to it, so well-known companies resolve from the shared graph (billed as entity-resolved). Defaults to the store the publisher configured; leave empty unless you run your own fork.

confidentThreshold.title: Confident-link threshold
confidentThreshold.description: Links at or above this confidence count as confident. Links below are still returned, flagged low confidence, and never charged.

probeActors.title: Actor probes (advanced)
probeActors.description: Only used when a Store Actor confirms a platform (auto/actors, or Instagram/Facebook when enableChildProbes is true). Maps a platform key to the Actor and how to read its output. Defaults (apify/instagram-profile-scraper, apify/facebook-pages-scraper, harvestapi/linkedin-company, clockworks/tiktok-profile-scraper, apidojo/twitter-user-scraper, compass/crawler-google-places) live in src/platforms.js; override here without a code change. Shape: { "instagram": { "actorId": "...", "input": { "usernames": ["{{id}}"] }, "externalUrlField": ["externalUrl","externalUrls"], "nameField": "fullName", "bioField": "biography" } }

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Proxy for website and direct-probe requests. Residential is rarely needed; the hub method reads the organization's own site.

requestTimeoutSecs.title: Request timeout (seconds)
requestTimeoutSecs.description: HTTP request timeout in seconds for website and platform fetches.

maxConcurrency.title: Max concurrent resolutions
maxConcurrency.description: Maximum number of organizations resolved in parallel.

renderFallbackActor.title: Render fallback Actor (advanced)
renderFallbackActor.description: For JavaScript-only websites. A Store Actor that returns rendered HTML in an `html` field for a `url` input (e.g. apify/web-fetch). Sub-runs bill to you. Leave empty to diagnose JS-only sites instead.

seedTimeoutSecs.title: Per-query timeout (seconds)
seedTimeoutSecs.description: One slow organization never stalls the run; abandoned queries get a `seed_timeout` diagnostic and are not charged.

perHostPerSecond.title: Politeness: requests per second per host
perHostPerSecond.description: Maximum requests per second to any single host (politeness limiter).

respectRobots.title: Respect robots.txt on organization websites
respectRobots.description: When a site's robots.txt disallows reading, Crosswalk reports `website_robots_denied` instead of reading it.

forgetIds.title: Forget: identifiers or canonicalIds to purge
forgetIds.description: forget mode only. Domains, platform URLs or org_… ids. Removes the record, its history and all indexes.

probeConcurrency.title: Parallel probes per organization
probeConcurrency.description: How many platform probes to run in parallel for one organization.

wikidataDeclared.title: Use Wikidata as a second declared source
wikidataDeclared.description: Wikidata's human-curated social properties for the organization whose official website is this domain are added as declared links (0.85) and still platform-verified. Independent of the website, so JS-only footers and robots-denied sites still resolve.

reverifySlice.title: Maintenance: Re-verify: slice index
reverifySlice.description: reverify mode only. Which slice (0..slices-1) to re-resolve today. Schedule with a rotating value or use a daily task per slice.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

reverifySlices.title: Maintenance: Re-verify: number of slices
reverifySlices.description: How many deterministic slices to partition the graph into for reverify mode.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

reverifyLimit.title: Maintenance: Re-verify: max organizations per run
reverifyLimit.description: Maximum number of organizations to re-verify in one run.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

seedSource.title: Maintenance: Seed: source
seedSource.description: seed mode only. list = seedDomains; sec = domains from the SEC index; wikidata = organizations with an official website (paged, resumable).; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

seedDomains.title: Maintenance: Seed: domains (list source)
seedDomains.description: Explicit list of domains to seed when seedSource is list.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

seedLimit.title: Maintenance: Seed: organizations per run
seedLimit.description: Maximum number of organizations to seed in one run.; publisher maintenance; not for buyer runs

leagues.title: Leagues or sports
leagues.description: Kambi paths, sport or league level: "basketball/nba", "american_football/nfl", "ice_hockey/nhl", "baseball/mlb", "football/england/premier_league", or a whole sport such as "tennis". Unknown paths are answered with suggestions and are never charged.

operators.title: Sportsbooks
operators.description: Kambi-powered books to price. Each book is a separate brand/jurisdiction feed; prices can differ between them. The list contains only books verified open on the date in the README.

markets.title: Markets
x-enumTitles: Every market incl. player props and alternates
markets.description: "main" returns the headline markets per game. "all" returns each game's full board (often 300–500 markets) and is priced higher.

includeLive.title: Include in-play games
includeLive.description: Include games already started (live prices at the moment of the run).

startsWithinHours.title: Only games starting within (hours)
startsWithinHours.description: 0 = no limit. Live games are kept when "Include in-play games" is on.

maxEvents.title: Max games
maxEvents.description: Soonest games first. You pay per game returned.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy (optional)
proxyConfiguration.description: On by default. Kambi limits how often one IP may ask; your run moves to a fresh Apify Proxy IP whenever it is slowed down. Turn off only to test without a proxy.

keywords.title: Keywords (full-text)
keywords.description: Optional. Mapped to TED expert-search FT~"…" full-text. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

expertQuery.title: Expert query (advanced)
expertQuery.description: Optional raw TED Expert Search expression. When set, overrides keywords / dates / noticeType / cpv / buyerCountry filters (you must include SORT BY yourself if desired). Example: buyer-country=DEU AND PD>=20260101 SORT BY publication-date DESC

publicationDateFrom.title: Publication date from (YYYY-MM-DD)
publicationDateFrom.description: Optional. Default: 14 days ago. Converted to TED PD>=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

publicationDateTo.title: Publication date to (YYYY-MM-DD)
publicationDateTo.description: Optional. Converted to TED PD<=YYYYMMDD. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

noticeType.title: Notice type
noticeType.description: Optional eForms notice-type filter (e.g. cn-standard, can-standard, pin-only, pin-cfc-standard). Ignored if expertQuery is set.

cpv.title: CPV code
cpv.description: Optional Common Procurement Vocabulary code (e.g. 72000000). Mapped to classification-cpv. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

buyerCountry.title: Buyer country (ISO3)
buyerCountry.description: Optional ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 buyer country (e.g. DEU, FRA, NLD). Mapped to buyer-country. Ignored if expertQuery is set.

scope.title: Search scope
scope.description: TED scope: ALL (archive) or ACTIVE (currently open). Default ALL.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Maximum notice rows to push to the default dataset.

Input_smartrecruiters_jobs_scraper.title: SmartRecruiters Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date

companies.title: SmartRecruiters company identifiers
companies.description: The identifier in the careers URL: https://jobs.smartrecruiters.com/<identifier>. One per line, or paste the URLs. Note: SmartRecruiters answers an unknown identifier with an empty list, so check spelling if you get zero postings.

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Add the plain-text job description to every posting. SmartRecruiters needs one extra request per returned posting for this.

companies.title: Ashby job board names
companies.description: The name in the board URL: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/<name>. One per line, or paste the URLs.

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

companies.title: Lever site names
companies.description: The site name in the board URL: https://jobs.lever.co/<site>. One per line, or paste the URLs.

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting.

maxResults.title: Max results

Input_greenhouse_jobs_scraper.title: Greenhouse Jobs Scraper — New Postings Since Any Date

companies.title: Greenhouse board tokens
companies.description: The token in the board URL: https://boards.greenhouse.io/<token> or https://job-boards.greenhouse.io/<token>. One per line, or paste the URLs.

since.title: Since
since.description: Return only postings published on or after this point. A window like 24h, 7d, 2w, or an ISO date/time such as 2026-09-01 or 2026-09-01T10:00:00Z. Leave empty for every open posting.

maxResults.title: Max results
maxResults.description: Cap on postings returned across all companies, newest first. Each returned posting is one billable result.

includeDescription.title: Include description
includeDescription.description: Add the plain-text job description to every posting.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: snapshot (Store QA prefill): serve matching opportunities from the published HF snapshot. monitor: serve HF delta events with eventDate >= since (near-$0 on a quiet window). enrich: snapshot plus future incumbent overlays (deferred in 0.1.32). rehashState: no-op on the public Actor (stateless; private producer only).

sources.title: Sources
sources.description: Allowed values: sam, grants. SAM defaults to daily Data Services CSV (samBulk=true, no key). Grants.gov needs no key.

samApiKey.title: SAM.gov API key
samApiKey.description: Optional when samBulk=true. Required only for API enrich (resourceLinks) / monitor checks / samBulk=false. Personal public API key from sam.gov (Account Details → Request API Key). Free. Stored encrypted; never logged.

agencies.title: Agencies
agencies.description: Names or codes, e.g. Department of Defense, DHS, EPA.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Free-text keywords matched against opportunity titles.

states.title: Place of performance states
states.description: Two-letter US state codes for place of performance (contracts).

noticeTypes.title: Notice types
noticeTypes.description: Filter by notice type, e.g. solicitation, award_notice, grant_posted.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within N days
postedWithinDays.description: Only include opportunities posted within the last N days. Declared product default is **14 days** (Thursday product window). Schedules and Store listing align to 14d; raise if you need a longer lookback (PPE scales with matches).

deadlineAfter.title: Deadline after
deadlineAfter.description: Defaults to today; excludes expired opportunities.

since.title: Since date
since.description: ET calendar date (YYYY-MM-DD) or RFC3339. Selects HF delta shards with eventDate >= since. Optional for snapshot (serves latest snapshot). For monitor, defaults to a 7-day lookback ending at the latest published delta date.

includeDescriptions.title: Include full descriptions
includeDescriptions.description: When true, fetch full grant synopses (slower).

includeContacts.title: Include official contacts
includeContacts.description: When true, include SAM point-of-contact fields.

enrichTopN.title: Incumbents per opportunity (enrich mode)
enrichTopN.description: Category leaders (or predecessors) per opportunity in enrich mode.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Hard cap on opportunity rows returned (and billed) after sort by postedDate desc → Sol#. Default 10000. Schema maximum 50000 so a buyer can opt into covering a full Active+14d/30d window (they pay PPE for what they take). Under the default 14d window, Active matches often exceed 10k — runs emit CAP_TRUNCATED + CAP_COVERAGE.covered/total (never silent). Cap always drops the oldest rows.

samBulk.title: Use SAM Data Services daily CSV (bulk)
samBulk.description: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility; private producer uses SAM Data Services CSV.

samEnrichLimit.title: SAM API enrich budget
samEnrichLimit.description: Ignored on the public Actor (v1.2 HF serve). Retained for input compatibility.

incumbentMode.title: Enrich join mode
incumbentMode.description: category_leaders (default): top USASpending recipients by agency×NAICS. predecessor: true prior-awardee/recompete join (stub until PREDECESSOR_JOIN.md ships). Proof schedules must keep default.

Input_grants_gov_scraper.title: Grants.gov Opportunities Scraper
Input_grants_gov_scraper.description: Public Grants.gov search2 API. No API key. Response token/accessKey are ignored. Server date filter: postedWithinDays → dateRange. open/close date fields are client-side (API does not support custom MM/DD ranges).

keyword.title: Keyword
keyword.description: Search keyword (e.g. education, cybersecurity). Leave empty for all.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Mapped to API body agencies (e.g. HHS, EPA, NSF).

status.title: Opportunity status
status.description: Mapped to API oppStatuses. Use forecasted|posted|closed|archived or pipe-joined.

postedWithinDays.title: Posted within N days
postedWithinDays.description: Server-side filter mapped to search2 dateRange (posted-date lookback). Verified values: 3,7,14,21,28,35,42,49,56,90,180,365. Omit for no posted-date filter.

openDateFrom.title: Open date from
openDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on openDate. Accepts MM/DD/YYYY or YYYY-MM-DD. Inclusive.

closeDateFrom.title: Close date from
closeDateFrom.description: Client-side filter on closeDate. Inclusive. Useful for 'still open' windows.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on opportunity rows (deduped by opportunityId).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch opportunity details
fetchDetails.description: Hydrate synopsis via fetchOpportunity. Still one PPE charge per opportunity.

Input_uk_find_a_tender_scraper.title: UK Find a Tender Scraper
Input_uk_find_a_tender_scraper.description: Public OCDS 1.1 packages from Find a Tender. Keywords and CPV are applied client-side after flatten.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Case-insensitive match on tender title, description, or buyer name (client-side).

cpv.title: CPV codes
cpv.description: Match when tender.items[].classification.id starts with any code (client-side).

noticeType.title: Notice stages
noticeType.description: Mapped to API stages: planning | tender | award. Omit for all.

Input_usaspending_awards_scraper.title: USASpending Awards Scraper
Input_usaspending_awards_scraper.description: Public USASpending.gov spending_by_award API. Defaults to recent contracts/IDVs (A–D) over the last 30 days. Emphasize agency / recipient / date filters.

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Mapped to filters.keywords. Leave empty for broad recent awards; prefer agency/recipient/date.

agency.title: Awarding agency (toptier name)
agency.description: Toptier awarding agency name → filters.agencies[{type:awarding,tier:toptier,name}]. Example: Department of Defense.

recipient.title: Recipient name
recipient.description: Mapped to filters.recipient_search_text (array). Example: Boeing. Verified shape requires an array of strings.

awardTypes.title: Award type codes
awardTypes.description: Default A,B,C,D (contracts/IDVs). Avoid assistance codes that may list individuals.

startDate.title: Start date
startDate.description: YYYY-MM-DD. Default: today − 30 days (recent awards window).

subawards.title: Subawards mode
subawards.description: Pass subawards flag to search (default false).

fetchDetails.title: Fetch award details
fetchDetails.description: Hydrate via GET /awards/{generated_internal_id}/. Still one PPE charge.

maxItems.title: Max items
maxItems.description: Cap on award rows (deduped by awardId|generatedInternalId).

mode.title: Mode
x-enumTitles: Lookup: a live number by source/series/geo/period
Score: a source's record on a series
Compare: rank sources on one question
Coverage: what the ledger can answer
Verify: provenance of a claim id
mode.description: text = hand it a sentence ("The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027"). lookup/score/compare use structured fields.

claim_text.title: Claim (text mode)
claim_text.description: Free-text claim for text mode (e.g. "The IMF expects Canada's economy to grow 1.8% in 2027").

source.title: Source organization
source.description: imf_weo | oecd_eo | fed_sep | spf | ecb_spf | pbo, or an issuer name; optional in text mode

series.title: Series
series.description: Generated from rules.yaml — every series the ledger resolves.

geo.title: Geography (ISO3 / EA / USA)
geo.description: ISO3 country code, EA, or USA. Required for most score/lookup/compare calls.

target_period.title: Target period (YYYY, YYYYQn, YYYY-MM)
